purpose: Replace only DAD policy architecture with a jointly trained soft MoE.
shared_initialization: Random candidate and fresh Fixed sequence, selected by validation independently for each policy.
shared_training: Pathwise sPCE, 2000 updates, batch32, Adam0.001, same training/validation RNG streams.
evaluation: 128 paired systems and observations-noise draws, seed1001; checkpoint selected on validation only.
acceptance: Report actual MoE-minus-DAD paired EIG and system-level SE; no superiority claim from architecture alone.
limitations: One training seed and one evaluation seed.
Four-expert policy has more parameters than DAD.
Shared Fixed calibration is part of both training pipelines and must be counted in compute costs.
Expert separation and router variation are diagnostics, not proof of useful specialization.
tests: 19 targeted unit/regression tests plus physical T3/T4/T5 gradient test and completed joint smoke.
